status: design artifact; no studio persistence or execution implemented

lineage_record.unknown_versions: null with unavailable state; never derive from timestamps or use frequency
lineage_record.immutable_binding: a candidate retains its exact input versions even if a library pointer changes
lineage_record.inferred_links: separate overlay with rationale and competing explanation; never silently enter observed closure

canonical_version.authority: explicit scoped declaration; a task-local authoritative source is not project-wide approval
canonical_version.frequency: high degree and further-work use never set canonical or approved
canonical_version.promotion: human decision records version, scope and event; derivative and preview are different relations

change_types.preview_representation: same immutable asset version with explicit raw/preview metadata: refresh representation; no semantic invalidation unless identity/content actually changed
change_types.asset_content_or_version: enumerate distinct direct media consumers and their transitive generation descendants
change_types.generation_output: enumerate descendants via all bound output assets, excluding the changed root
change_types.reference_membership_or_identity: enumerate actual reference-bound consumers, then generation descendants; metadata grouping alone is not an executed input
change_types.canonical_pointer: future tasks see proposed new binding; existing candidates retain their old inputs and become review candidates only in declared scope
change_types.preset_or_unknown: show separately with raw role/path; review adapter meaning before treating it as material propagation

review_rules: Return unique film-scoped IDs and supporting edge paths; cycles terminate and are disclosed.
Mark candidates needs_review with the changed source/version and cause; never delete, rerun, reject or revoke approval automatically.
Propagate needs_review through observed material dependencies; aliases, hidden edges and external work remain coverage warnings, never invented edges.
Keep review of descendants separate from human resolution: keep existing, rebind, regenerate or explicitly approve replacement.
Preserve previous decisions and input bindings; record actor, rationale, replacement and scope for each new decision.
An empty disclosed closure is zero known descendants, not proof of zero production impact.
validation_tests: Synthetic diamond counts descendants once, preserves both supporting paths, and leaves disconnected component untouched.
Synthetic cycle terminates; same IDs in a second film never join.
Raw/min representations under one asset leave fan-out unchanged; identical-looking URLs across IDs do not merge identities.
Unresolved producer remains unresolved; changing its asset still enumerates known consumers.
Repeated reference name or high degree creates neither version nor approval.
A canonical pointer change preserves existing immutable input bindings and awaits a scoped human decision.
